thread:
maria (AE): Heads-up: PhoenixHealth wants a 2-week POC. Must-haves: SAML SSO (SP + IdP flows), SCIM (delta + initial bulk ~6k users), group->role mapping, per-team subdomain tenancy with DNS TXT proof, and audit/export for provisioning events. Their security team attached a questionnaire and flagged BYOK + HSM as a possible contract requirement. Can we do a short alignment call today?

tony (SE): I can take 20m. Quick clarifiers: NameID preferences? signed vs encrypted assertions? Also confirm whether they require SP-init only.

lina (Security): High-level blockers: signed assertions required; encryption preferred if they pass PHI; ACS endpoints must be HTTPS and support HSTS; audit retention they ask for is 18 months (we default to 90 days hosted). BYOK/HSM + extended retention likely force Private. Also need SCIM delta history and immutable audit logs, plus SCIM retry/backoff semantics documented. DNS TXT tenant proof required.

sam (Solutions): For the customer, prepare this SCIM mapping example to send to Okta/Azure: ```json
{"scimMapping": {"userName": "userPrincipalName","displayName": "name.formatted","groups": "groups","tenant": "urn:phoenix:tenantId"}}
```

ton y (SE): For SAML metadata, send them this sample to give to their IdP admin: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://phoenix.redwood.example/sp\">\n  <SPSSODescriptor>\n    <AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://phoenix.redwood.example/saml/acs\"/>\n  </SPSSODescriptor>\n</EntityDescriptor>
```

maria (AE): Pricing check: does BYOK/HSM + long retention require Dedicated/Private? They are cautious on spend.

tony (SE): Short: BYOK/HSM plus contractual retention guarantees => Private in most cases. For POC we can enable hosted demo with temporary elevated retention (written ack) and temporary SCIM rate increases for the import. Sustained bulk windows and SLA-backed guarantees are Dedicated/Private. I'll confirm exact thresholds with product.

lina (Security): Also request: their IdP vendor (Okta/Azure/Ping), planned provisioning cadence (near-real-time vs nightly), and evidence of tenant org ownership (company docs + DNS TXT). If they insist on mTLS to ACS endpoints or customer-provided certs that’s also Private-only.

provision-bot: Note: demo-provisioner cluster allocated until 2024-06-12T18:00Z. Request extension via #eng-infra at least 24h before expiry.

sam (Solutions): Troubleshoot checklist to include in follow-up: assertion viewer steps, cert thumbprint check, clock skew tolerance, NameID format mismatch, and SCIM bearer token troubleshooting. Also include fallback plan: host tokens for POC UX if SAML delays block initial demo (call out that fallback doesn't meet compliance).

maria (AE): Action items: 1) @tony draft SAML metadata + troubleshooting 2) @sam send SCIM mapping + bulk-import steps to customer 3) @lina mark questionnaire items that force Private 4) I'll prep a provisional pricing note that shows Hosted POC path vs Dedicated/Private options.

tony (SE): I'll also prepare a short script for verifying DNS TXT proof: ```bash
# verify tenant TXT
dig +short TXT tenant.phoenix.example
# expect: "redwood-tenant=phoenix-<id>"
```

maria (AE): Great. I'll book 30m and add their IdP admin + procurement. Please upload draft questionnaire responses to this thread after the pre-call so I can forward. :white_check_mark:
